import json

# Try the freshly fetched data first, fall back to existing cache
for path in [
    r"c:\\Users\\owner\\Desktop\\economic-platform\\temp_yoy_data.json",
    r"c:\\Users\\owner\\Desktop\\economic-platform\\temp_au_qcpi_fresh.json",
]:
    try:

            raw = json.load\(f\)
        print\(f"Loaded data from: {path}"\)
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f"Could not load {path}: {e}"\)
        continue
else:
    print\("No data file found!"\)
    exit\(1\)

# The API may return data directly as a list, or nested under a key
if isinstance\(raw, list\):
    data = raw
elif isinstance\(raw, dict\):
    # Try common keys
    for key in ["data", "quarterly_cpi", "results"]:
        if key in raw:
            data = raw[key]
            break
    else:
        print\(f"Dict keys: {list\(raw.keys\(\)\)[:20]}"\)
        for k, v in raw.items\(\):
            if isinstance\(v, list\):
                data = v
                print\(f"Using key '{k}' which has {len\(v\)} items"\)
                break
        else:
            print\("Could not find data list in response"\)
            print\(f"Top-level structure: { {k: type\(v\).__name__ for k, v in raw.items\(\)} }"\)
            exit\(1\)

print\(f"Total data points: {len\(data\)}"\)
print\(\)

# Show a sample record to understand the structure
if data:
    print\(f"Sample record keys: {list\(data[0].keys\(\)\)}"\)
    print\(f"Sample record: {json.dumps\(data[0], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2\)}"\)
    print\(\)

    \("weighted_median_yoy", "加重中央値（前年比）"\),
    \("trimmed_mean_yoy", "トリム平均（前年比）"\),
    \("cpi_sa_yoy", "CPI季調済（前年比）"\),
]

for field_name, label in fields:

        print\(f"  Last date:  {last_date} \(value: {last.get\(field_name\)}\)"\)
    else:
        print\("  No non-null values found"\)

# Also check if there are related fields we might be missing

    yoy_keys = [k for k in sorted\(all_keys\) if "yoy" in k.lower\(\) or "year" in k.lower\(\)]

# Now analyze the Excel file
print\("\\n" + "="*80\)
print\("ANALYZING EXCEL FILE"\)
print\("="*80\)

xls = pd.ExcelFile\(filepath\)
print\(f"\\nSheet names \({len\(xls.sheet_names\)}\):"\)
for i, name in enumerate\(xls.sheet_names\):
    print\(f"  {i}: {name}"\)

# Analyze each sheet
for sheet_name in xls.sheet_names:
    print\(f"\\n{'='*80}"\)
    print\(f"SHEET: {sheet_name}"\)
    print\(f"{'='*80}"\)
    
    try:
        df = pd.read_excel\(filepath, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=None, nrows=20\)
        print\(f"Shape: {df.shape}"\)
        
        # Print first 15 rows x 20 cols
        pd.set_option\('display.max_columns', 20\)
        pd.set_option\('display.width', 300\)
        pd.set_option\('display.max_colwidth', 40\)
        
        subset = df.iloc[:15, :20]
        print\(subset.to_string\(\)\)
        
        # Search for keywords in entire sheet
        df_full = pd.read_excel\(filepath, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=None\)
        print\(f"\\nFull shape: {df_full.shape}"\)
        
        keywords = ["SNEQ", "SG01RSC00B01", "GDP", "Gross domestic product", 
                     "Production", "Expenditure", "Percentage", "growth", "percent",
                     "Chain volume", "Actual", "Seasonally"]
        
        for kw in keywords:
            found = []
            for r in range\(min\(30, len\(df_full\)\)\):
                for c in range\(min\(30, len\(df_full.columns\)\)\):
                    val = str\(df_full.iloc[r, c]\)
                    if kw.lower\(\) in val.lower\(\):
                        found.append\(\(r, c, val[:80]\)\)
            if found:
                print\(f"\\n  Found '{kw}':"\)
                for r, c, v in found[:5]:
                    print\(f"    Row {r}, Col {c}: {v}"\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f"  Error reading sheet: {e}"\)

print\("\\n\\nDone!"\)
